verdict.rationale: The service page names who may act: any person with Cartão de Cidadão or Chave Móvel Digital, lawyers, notaries and solicitors with their professional-order certificate, and foreign citizens via CMD or eIDAS. It also states that the auto-generated pacto social must be digitally signed by all sócios, which makes that signature personal. Intervenientes must separately authorize data sharing, and SCAP lets people sign in their company role. Missing for 10: any published authorization or mandate forms (e.g., procuração), an explicit scope of what a professional intermediary may and may not do for the founder, and a consolidated list of non-delegable acts beyond the pact signature.
